title: Queensland disaster management map layers
intended_use: State-level and regional thematic maps (about 2 km per screen pixel). Reduced size and precision; not for pinpoint locations, address lookups or legal boundaries.
region_slug_rule: lower-case Police Region Short Name with spaces replaced by underscores

layers.title: Queensland disaster districts (DDMG)
layers.description: The 23 disaster districts, each coordinated by a District Disaster Management Group. Includes Queensland's coastal waters as in the source. Simplified with a 200 m tolerance for state-level views; not for pinpoint locations.
layers.source: QPS Disaster Districts, Queensland Police Service, via the Queensland Government Open Data Portal

layers.title: Queensland local government areas (LDMG)
layers.description: The 78 local government area polygons covered by the 77 Local Disaster Management Groups (Torres Strait carries two councils under one group). Includes coastal waters as in the source; Cook Shire's Gulf of Carpentaria water box removed using the ABS ASGS 2021 coastline. Simplified with a 200 m tolerance for state-level views; not for pinpoint locations.
layers.feature_id: LGA Code (Queensland local government area code)
layers.source: Local government area boundaries - Queensland, Department of Natural Resources and Mines, Manufacturing and Regional and Rural Development; ASGS Edition 3 (2021) Local Government Areas, Australian Bureau of Statistics

layers.title: Disaster Management Regions
layers.description: The 23 disaster districts merged into the 7 Disaster Management Regions they report to. Disaster Management Region: the reporting grouping of disaster districts used by the consuming reports. Not the QPS operational region boundary - see qld_qps_regions_gda94_simp200m.
layers.source: QPS Disaster Districts, Queensland Police Service, via the Queensland Government Open Data Portal
